target.title: fix(codex): classify commandExecution mutability via shared isMutatingToolCall
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes #101890 — strict-agentic retry cannot retry terminal turns that only
performed read-only shell commands because `isMutatingNativeToolItem` always
treats `commandExecution` items as mutating.

## Root Cause

`isReplaySafeToolCall` returns `false` for all `exec`/`bash` calls even though
a read-only shell classifier already exists. `isMutatingNativeToolItem` then
treats all `commandExecution` items as mutating.

## Fix

Use `isReplaySafeToolCall("exec", itemToolArgs(item))` in
`isMutatingNativeToolItem` instead of unconditionally returning `true`.
Imported from the existing internal module (no new SDK API surface).

## Evidence

### Runtime Proof: `isReplaySafeToolCall` production function

Before (main `4bf70be01a`):

```
isReplaySafeToolCall("exec", args) — main (before fix)
============================================================
  ❌ rg TODO                  → replaySafe: false
  ❌ ls -la                   → replaySafe: false
  ❌ cat                      → replaySafe: false
```

After (PR head `5b35ae64`):

```
isReplaySafeToolCall("exec", args) — PR #102106 head
============================================================
  ✅ rg TODO                  → replaySafe: true
  ✅ ls -la                   → replaySafe: true
  ✅ cat                      → replaySafe: true
  ❌ echo > file (write)      → replaySafe: false
  ❌ rm -rf                   → replaySafe: false
  ❌ npm install              → replaySafe: false
```

Read-only commands are now classified as replay-safe; mutating commands remain
fail-closed.

Full chain: `isMutatingNativeToolItem → isSideEffectingNativeToolItem →
recordToolMeta → sideEffectingToolItemIds → hadPotentialSideEffects →
replayMetadata`.

Command run:
```
node --import tsx -e 'import { isReplaySafeToolCall } from "./src/agents/tool-mutation.js"; ...'
```

### Autoreview (claude-sonnet-5)

→ patch is correct (0.98), no accepted/actionable findings

### Test Results

- `extensions/codex/src/app-server/outcome-fallback-runtime-contract.test.ts` — 7/7 passed
- `src/agents/tool-mutation.test.ts` — read-only shell classification tests passed

- [x] oxfmt + oxlint pass
- [x] No new SDK API surface
- [x] autoreview clean (0.98)
